criteria.reasoning: After the SIM digression, the bot does not return to the card workflow at all, so it never re-asks which card to replace or why it needs replacing, nor does it restart any completed steps.

criteria.criterion: The card replacement order is confirmed by the end of the conversation, and the agent audibly shares its order ID.
